title: Read a form into the field repository
summary: Reads the fields and calc / event code of a DFM into the field repository; a join field gets its own table, a calc over several tables its child end
intro: Read this when the fields of a form should become rows of the field repository. drag-lint repo read-dfm reads a text or binary DFM and its unit, prints the changes that bring the repository in line with them, and writes only with --apply or --select. What the DFM does not state is reported, never guessed.

questions.ask: How do I read the persistent fields and calc code of a form into the repository?
Which datasets of a form have a table drag-lint can name?
Which table does each calc and lookup field of a join belong to, and why does a field get none?
Where does a calc field that reads several tables of a join go, and which inputs and relations does it need?
Which table does a memory table filled by AttachedTo, CloneCursor or CopyDataSet hold?
